basic_info.description: Nestled in the sought-after Westwood Park neighborhood, this fully detached Single Family Home is brimming with old-school charm and waiting to be brought back to its former glory! Proudly maintained in the same family for more than 50 years. The home is filled with natural light from its big windows on all 4 sides. The home comes with new roof, Milgard double pane windows, newer water heater, newer garage door, and beautiful original hardwood floors. Featuring 2 spacious bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a formal living room with wood burning fireplace, a formal dining room, and a huge 1000 SqFt unfinished ground floor. This home offers a versatile layout with endless possibilities. Steps to Whole Foods, City College of San Francisco, library, cafes, restaurants, Chinese groceries, and many shops along the Ocean Avenue corridor. Near MUNI and BART transit as well. From its classic original details to its timeless character, this home is a rare find. While this home is in need of some attention, it presents an unparalleled opportunity for restoration and transformation. Opportunities like this don't come often in such a coveted neighborhood - don't miss your chance to make this beauty shine again! Schedule your private tour today!
